def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining_capacity = bins - item
    # Prioritize bins with more remaining capacity
    # Use a small positive offset to avoid division by zero and ensure all values are positive
    priority_scores = 1 / (remaining_capacity + 1e-8)
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - (bins - bins)  # Ensure bins is not modified
    valid_mask = remaining >= item
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    priorities[valid_mask] = remaining[valid_mask]
    return priorities
